infrastructure: San Marino uses Italian telecommunications networks, providing reasonable urban connectivity.
Very small territory (61 km²) and population make dedicated AI infrastructure impractical.
Dependent entirely on Italy for internet backbone connectivity.
talent: University of the Republic of San Marino has very limited tech research capacity.
Tiny population (34,000) severely limits the talent pool.
Many San Marinese work across the border in Italy's tech sector.
governance: One of the world's oldest republics with stable, transparent governance.
Aligned with Italian and EU data protection standards through cooperation agreements.
No dedicated AI governance framework; relies on Italian and EU regulatory guidance.
investment: Financial services and manufacturing (ceramics, textiles) dominate; AI-specific investment is negligible.
Low tax environment attracts some international businesses.
economic_readiness: Micro-economy dependent on tourism, manufacturing, and financial services.
Very limited domestic AI market and virtually no AI startup activity.
GDP per capita is high, but market scale is negligible.
